comment: Photo-scanned texture sets of the terrain layers, all CC0: from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com/license) unless source is ambientcg (https://ambientcg.com, CC0 too). fetch_texture_sources.ps1 downloads them to Saved/TextureSources/<source>/<id> as <id>_color.jpg, <id>_normal.jpg and <id>_height.jpg, import_texture_sources.py imports them and puts them into DA_HexTerrainLayers, but only into a layer that has no texture yet or still the generated one, and sets tileSize, scree and gravel only on a layer it adds or fills, so what an artist set there stays. Each set gives a color, a DirectX normal and a height.
